notes.title: v1.02 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi!

v1.02 of Unwording contains the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue on day 3 where pressing the Enter key without any text input would trigger an interaction.
[*] Added a message on day 3 that informs the player if they are about to leave the area without having interacted with anything on the street level.
[*] Fixed collision issues outside the music store on the street on day 3
[*] Updated the texture of the food eaten by Tom at home on day 3
[*] Fixed an issue where Tom would get stuck looking at the baby after interacting with it on day 3
[/list]

Thanks for playing, and let me know if there are any other issues you've come across!

-Armaan

notes.title: Thank you for playing Unwording!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Now that it's been a week since the launch, I just wanted to leave a quick message of thanks, for playing the game, for the lovely response and the reviews, and for making the launch week such a success!

This was a small and personal project, so the positive reception the game has received has been beyond my expectations. It makes me super happy to hear that the themes have resonated with you all - that is mainly why I make games!

If you'd like to stay up to date on updates and future project, you can sign up to the once-in-a-few-months newsletter here - https://frostwoodinteractive.com/

notes.title: Unwording is OUT NOW!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm happy to announce that after over a year of work, Unwording is finally out! :)

The game launches at $4.99, with a 10% discount - so if you've been interested in the game, the best time to get it would be now! It also really helps in getting the game picked up by Steam's algorithm if it's bought (and reviewed!) in the first 24 hours. This would be SUPER helpful and appreciated!

Thank you for all the support - this has been quite a personal game with a lot of learnings from my own life and experiences, and I sincerely hope you like the game and that it resonates with you!

Lastly, below is the launch trailer. And if you need help with anything, or just want to get in touch, drop me a mail at armaan@frostwoodinteractive.com

notes.title: Unwording demo update v0.1.4
notes.notes:
Hi!

Unwording demo's v0.1.4 is live now, and it incorporates all of your feedback on the previous version of the demo. There are a huge number of improvements and changes including:

Improved framerate during puzzles
Increased rotation speed and polished rotation for cubes
Added a tutorial for the puzzle sections
Added more context for each puzzle
Fixed cubes acting finicky, changing size, or not getting registered correctly when positioned in the right spot
Removed sound when rotating cubes
Added a feature that lets players swap out a cube if they place a cube on an already occupied slot
Overhauled and improved the visuals for the puzzles
Small camera and navigation bug fixes
Here's a comparison showing the old vs new style of the puzzles -

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42291102/05d0d277316b9f8d62fa84586c46b02c01e66bf1.gif[/img]

If you liked the demo, please consider wishlisting on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1974250/Unwording

Thanks for playing the demo!

Armaan

notes.title: Unwording devlog #2 - back to work, and working on improvements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you for playing the Unwording demo and for all the helpful feedback. A few days after releasing the demo, I had to leave for a conference and an extended trip to the UK - talks with publishers, networking, and a little bit of vacation afterward!

Refreshed, motivated, and filled with new ideas, I'm back home and ready to get back to development. The first thing I shall be getting to is working on all the feedback I've received so far. The two major points are - 

Slow performance during puzzles, esp when rotating cubes, and
Confusion/ lack of clarity regarding the game's objectives.
Look out for an update in the coming few days, and give the demo a shot if you haven't yet!

-Armaan
